# Let me click the remaining green block and see what happens
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    print(f"  center~({center_r}, {center_c})")

# Click it
if green_nodes:
    gn = green_nodes[0]
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    print(f"Clicked. Done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Now let me try a different approach - maybe I need to move the character to the passage
# and then use ACTION7 to "jump" up

# First reset to left
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
print(f"\nAfter ACTION7: character at {char['boundary']}")

# Now move right step by step and try ACTION7 at each position
for i in range(6):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
    pos = char['boundary']
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in pos) // len(pos)
    print(f"After RIGHT #{i+1}: character at col ~{center_c}")
    
    # Try ACTION7 at this position
    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
    new_pos = char['boundary']
    new_center_c = sum(p[1] for p in new_pos) // len(new_pos)
    new_center_r = sum(p[0] for p in new_pos) // len(new_pos)
    green_count = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5])
    print(f"  ACTION7: char at ({new_center_r}, {new_center_c}), green={green_count}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
